chat_translation_handoff.instruction: Before translating later chapters, read state.json first. Reuse unchanged canonical authorities already loaded in the same project chat, but freshly read every newly named or changed supplement. Read config.json, the canonical terminology TSV, the core style guide, every terminology, style, owner-edit, world-reference, and continuity supplement named in this handoff, chat-fast-path.md, and the registered project-source file Being A Talent: World Reference and Appendix when relevant. Repository files outrank chat memory; the canonical glossary and the latest owner ruling override older reference entries. Preserve one target paragraph per source paragraph. Italicize explicit and unmistakable implicit internal thought, including an unspoken thought explicitly conveyed through a character's tone. Direct thought generally uses present tense, with past or past perfect reserved for genuine recollection, anterior events, counterfactuals, and other real sequence needs. Use natural contractions except those ending in 'd. Preserve all source meaning, numbers, logical relations, idioms, allusions, jokes, and metaphor chains in polished xianxia English. Apply the latest owner style directly: compact causal explanations, forceful but accurate action, clear combat geography, short emphatic beats where the source supports them, and no repeated explanation. Preserve an idiom's function and cultural force without forcing a literal image when it makes the English unnatural. Formal displayed decrees retain bold corner brackets; ordinary technique and artifact call-outs remain plain unless an owner-final term naturally includes an article. Locked Chapter 1253 rulings include Beheading Pending Review, his single body possessed three avatars, the Immortal Kingdom Daoist Law, seal script, the spiritual qi of heaven and earth, rise to the challenge, when events turn abnormal, there's always something behind it, and establish statutes and enforce the law. Keep chapter prose in chat unless the owner explicitly requests repository chapter files. Under the chat-only fast path, search only the current chapter's actual terms, avoid broad web or repository research when authorities already resolve them, make one translation pass and one separate source-grounded check, deliver the complete chapter before repository maintenance, make no provisional handoff commit, and publish one atomic glossary, style, continuity, world-reference, and state update only after owner approval or edited prose.
